rdf:Description.rdfs:label: validatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been validated on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: high
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 7.0 - 8.9.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the software support channel or other support information for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasContactPoint
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact has each `to` Agent as a contact point. The use of the `hasContactPoint` type is constrained to `ContactPointRelationship` classed relationships. The type of contact (i.e. security) may be specified using a `ContactPointRelationship` element.
Specifies the type of the external identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibrn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Registration Number (IBRN)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a unique identifier for legal entities standardized by [ISO 8000-116](https://www.iso.org/standard/75117.html). It is composed of two parts: a jurisdiction prefix and a local authoritative legal entity identifier (ALEI), separated by a colon. The prefix contains an ISO 3166 country code, an optional subdivision code, and a register code (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iban
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) is a system for identifying bank accounts across national borders standardized by [ISO 13616](https://www.iso.org/standard/81090.html). It consists of up to 34 alphanumeric characters, including a country code, two check digits, and a basic bank account number. While spaces may be inserted for human readability, they must be omitted when used for electronic data exchange (e.g., `IE64IRCE92050112345678`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mailingList
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the mailing list used by the maintainer for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOutput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build, DefinedProcess or Action element generates each `to` Element as an output.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data points in the dataset can be shared only with specific organizations and their clients on a need to know basis.
A prescribed alteration of a product.
A planned location where a good, product, or material is inspected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The file represents a single file (default).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: act
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions. CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.
Identifies the full text of a License or Addition.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: packageUrl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Package-URL (PURL), as defined in [ECMA-427](https://ecma-international.org/publications-and-standards/standards/ecma-427/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated as part of the process of building the software to create a releasable artifact (e.g., executable or package) from data such as source files, dependencies, built components, build process ephemeral data, and other SBOMs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: riskAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a risk assessment for a package.
Threshold that was used for computation of a metric described in the metric field.
ManufactureAction represents the act of creating a product by a manufacturing process.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/SupplyChain/ModifyProcess is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Records the biases that the dataset is known to encompass.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: core
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Core profile specification.
Harvest is the process of extracting goods or products from nature.
Version string for an Element.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where only one of the elements applies.
Specifies the CVSS base, temporal, threat, or environmental severity type.
A collection of SPDX Elements describing a single package.
Specifies the exploit catalog type.
HarvestAction represents the act of creating a product by directly extracting goods or materials from nature.
The amount or measure of a bulk product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Build profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single file which can be independently distributed (configuration file, statically linked binary, Kubernetes deployment, etc.).
A planned path used to move people, goods, data, or resources from one location to another.
Provides a License author's preferred text to indicate that a file is covered by the License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: install
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is used to install software on disk.
Provides a CVSS version 2.0 assessment for a vulnerability.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/version](../../Core/Properties/version.md) instead.
Identify the version of a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 4.0 - 6.9.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: autonomous
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 6 - Autonomous. The system is capable of modifying its intended domain of use or its goals without external intervention, control or oversight.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the documentation for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: draft
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Not yet finalized; under development or review.
Information about the AI software, not including the model description.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is of a type not included in this list.
Potentially noisy elements of the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pass
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a successful evaluation where the requirement or condition is clearly met.
A point representing the mean position of the matter in a body or system.
Sponsor of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: All other simulation types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any specification that does not fall under any of the other entries.
Abstract class for additional text intended to be added to a License, but which is not itself a standalone License.
Property describes the invocation entrypoint of a build.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: query
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available, but not all at once, and can only be accessed through queries which return parts of the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crystalsDilithium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Dilithium](https://pq-crystals.org/dilithium/)
Timestamp of impact statement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element (the instructions) runs on each `to` /Hardware/Hardware (processing element), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
An actual change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inspection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A thorough examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence. An inspection needs to have a defined set of acceptance criteria (e.g. a checklist), a documentation of roles involved in the inspection (e.g. to document the inspector's independence) and a clear documentation of when and how it was performed.
The readiness of a process.
This individual element was defined by the spec.
Property that describes the URI of the build configuration source file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such as a social network of friends.
A container for a grouping of SPDX 3 content characterizing details (provenance, composition, licensing, etc.) about a product.
A software agent.
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.
Provides information about the creation of the Element.
The action of product use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) report.
An entity that is authorized to issue identification credentials.
How the dataset was collected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: no
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates absence of the field.
Specifies the type of an external identifier.
Specifies whether an additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.
Methods that can be used to explain the results from the AI model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tls
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Transport Layer Security, or TLS, is a widely adopted security protocol designed to facilitate privacy and data security for communications over the Internet.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC or SWIFT code, is a unique 8 or 11-character alphanumeric code standardized by [ISO 9362](https://www.iso.org/standard/84108.html) to identify financial and non-financial institutions (e.g., `BBWCUS33`).
The measure of length refers to the dimension of an object or space that describes how long it is, typically expressed in various units depending on the system of measurement being used.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: high
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The second-highest level of risk posed by an AI system.
Verification preconditions are initial criteria that are to be met prior to initiating the verification method.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.
Denote whether a CVE is present in an exploit catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: yes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates presence of the field.
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: backlog
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement has been captured and logged, but not yet ready to become a formal requirement draft. A backlog requirement may still be incomplete or ambiguous.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exportControlAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an export control assessment for a package.
Abstract ancestor class for all vulnerability assessments.
Provides a map of a property name to a value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsoleted
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Superseded or not valid at present.
Unit of energy consumption.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Concise Software Identification (CoSWID) tag, as defined in [RFC 9393](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9393/) Section 2.3.
UnitOfMeasure specify information structures through industry standards for Units of Measure, Quantity Kinds, Dimensions and Data Types.
Street address includes a street number, name and unit ID to identify a specific street.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: attend
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, and may involve publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities sooner than standard update timelines.
Abstract class representing a License or an OrLaterOperator.
Specifies the version of a VEX statement.
This is the planned individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.
Provides a place for the SPDX data creator to record acknowledgement text for a software Package, File or Snippet.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasInput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Build/Build, DefinedProcess or Action element has each `to` Element as an input.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A generic contact point to be used when the contact type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hardware
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Hardware profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: functionalSafety
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the FunctionalSafety profile specification.
Products out of specification require a resolution action. This is the action of resolution.
Provides a set of values to be used to describe the common types of SBOMs that tools may create.
Provides an unambiguous mechanism for conveying a URI fragment portion of an Element ID.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: locatedAt
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: `from` Element located at a specific `to` Location. A time period is optional.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for support.
An entity providing an assessment.

Enumeration of the different kinds of SPDX file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.
Weight to express relevance in de minimis consideration.
A key with an associated value.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A `from` /Security/Vulnerability has been fixed in each `to` Element. The use of the `fixedIn` type is constrained to `/Security/VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: privacyAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a privacy assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: container
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a container image which can be used by a container runtime application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssessmentFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security assessment. The use of the `hasAssessmentFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ai
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the AI profile specification.
The valid state for DefinedStateProcess.
Records the time when a recommended action was communicated in a VEX statement to mitigate a vulnerability.
Information related to hardware dimension.
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.
Capture the scope of information about a specific relationship between elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasExample
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is an example for the `from` Element (`from` hasExample `to`).
Defines the line range in the original host file that the snippet information applies to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: qualityAssessmentReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a quality assessment for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdvisory
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a published security advisory (where advisory is defined per [ISO 29147:2018](https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html)) that may affect one or more elements, e.g., vendor advisories or specific NVD entries.
Expression for the export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).
Energy consumed when training the AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: executable
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an Artifact that can be run on a computer.
Provides a reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: npm
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an npm package. The package locator format is defined in the [npm documentation](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/package-json) and looks like `package@version`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_384
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 384, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-2 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [RFC 6234](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc6234/).
The name of the recipient expressed in text.
Describes if a given file is a directory or non-directory kind of file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endOfSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is a defined end of support for the artifact from the supplier. This may also be referred to as end of life. There is a validUntilDate that can be used to signal when support ends for the artifact.
Identifies the name of an Element as designated by the creator.
roleQualification specifies the requirements, criteria, or conditions that must be met for an entity to be considered qualified to fulfill a particular role.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assumes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element assumes each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to store extra information about an Element which is not part of a review (e.g. extra information provided during the creation of the Element).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: module
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a module of a piece of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serializedInArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` SpdxDocument can be found in a serialized form in each `to` Artifact.
A concrete subclass of Element used by Individuals in the Core profile.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildSystem

Energy consumed during inference time by an AI model that is being used in the AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: green
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset can be shared within a community of peers and partners.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: demonstration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Demonstrating and monitoring or recording that the item under verification to confirm that a requirement is met by the item under verification.
A location where a package or an item will be picked up.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other specialized or custom verification method that fits the context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/european-case-law-identifier-ecli) is a uniform identifier for judicial decisions across Europe. It consists of five mandatory components: the "ECLI" prefix, a country code, a court code, the year of the decision, and a unique serial number (e.g., `ECLI:EU:C:2023:94`).
Describes if any sensitive personal information is present in the dataset.
Provides information about the creation of the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Lite profile specification.
A verificationUID is a unique identifier assigned to a Verification item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDependencyManifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has manifest files that contain dependency information in each `to` Element.
A buildType is a hint that is used to indicate the toolchain, platform, or infrastructure that the build was invoked on.
Provides information about the type of an SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dependsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

A license expression participating in a license set.
References an Element on the right-hand side of a relationship.
Specifies the SPDX License List version in which this ListedLicense or ListedLicenseException identifier was first added.
Provides the location of an external reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doi
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Digital Object Identifier (DOI)](https://www.doi.org/the-identifier/what-is-a-doi/) is a unique, [ISO 26324](https://www.iso.org/standard/88862.html)-standardized identifier for physical, digital, or abstract objects, formatted as a prefix and suffix separated by a forward slash (e.g., `10.1000/182`).
EvidenceType refers to categories of documented or observable proof used to verify compliance, qualification, or performance
Test Process defines the testing process for an element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake3
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [BLAKE3](https://github.com/BLAKE3-team/BLAKE3-specs/blob/master/blake3.pdf)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cycle
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation architectures with precise cycle-level accuracy.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: red
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data points in the dataset are highly confidential and can only be shared with named recipients.
Software provided as a service over a network.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: syntactic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data describes the syntax or semantics of a language or text, such as a parse tree used for natural language processing.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software manifest.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issueTracker
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the issue tracker for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Identifier (IBID)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a verifiable unique identifier for legal entities as defined in the [ISO/DIS 25500-3](https://www.iso.org/standard/87705.html) draft standard. It is composed of three data elements: the International Business Registration Number (IBRN), the legal name, and the date of origin formatted as eight numeric characters (YYYYMMDD). Each element is separated by a pipe character (`|`) (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657|Code Management Association|19990420`).
ResponsibilityChangeAction refers to the transfer of responsibility from one party to another.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition, in SPDX templating format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crl
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Certificate Revocation List, or CRL, is a list of revoked certificates that is downloaded from the Certificate Authority (CA).
Information about the relationship between two Elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: custody
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Custody refers to the responsibility, control, and safekeeping of an asset, person, or legal entity. It involves both physical possession and legal authority over something or someone.
An assertion made in relation to one or more elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Legislation Identifier (ELI)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/content/help/eurlex-content/eli.html) is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) that uniquely identifies a legal resource, typically consisting of a document type, adoption year, and document number (e.g., `http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj`).
Categories of presence or absence.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandedLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the ExpandedLicensing profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense

If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists of unstructured text, such as a book, a Wikipedia article (without images), or a transcript.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityThreatModel

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to funding information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).

A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
